digest.component_or_area: external integration test harness and CI workflow
propositions: A parameterized live-call harness is needed under tests/external/ to measure raw output distributions across (provider, model, directive) cells from .github/llm-providers/*.toml configuration.

The harness must run fixed n=10 samples of two production-shaped prompts per cell, capture raw replies as artifacts, and score deterministically using current and sentinel parsers with layout-class rates.
A workflow_dispatch-only CI job must enforce per-run call budget (default 300) and skip unmeasured cells (missing credentials) without failing, using Python logic testable offline.
Scorer logic must be fully unit-testable against committed E2 reply fixtures with pinned golden counts, independent of live API calls.
Before/after raw-output distributions and per-cell PASS/FAIL facts must be captured and uploaded as an artifact bundle linked to the epic.
